description: Shows the status of the candidate's own job applications at Modulos, and only those: the applications of the address that received the code from request_application_status_code. The status is private to the candidate: show it only to them. Ask the candidate for the code; do not guess it. Show each application's status and details exactly as they are given and add nothing of your own: no guess about the candidate's chances, the outcome or when they will hear back. If there are no applications, say so. For anything else, the candidate can write to jobs@modulos.ai, quoting the reference of the application.

email.description: Email address the candidate applied with. The code is sent there.

name: get_application_status
